audit: Wave 9 / agent 53 / protected authored content audit
scopeOfPass: Protected source/content identity and reviewed runtime scope only; not game-wide rendering, native-browser, physics-equivalence or full-CI acceptance.

method.treeEnumeration: git ls-tree -r -z at both immutable commits; no reliance on baseline worktree completeness
method.workingBytes: Stream every protected and reviewed-runtime file in 1 MiB chunks; SHA-1 of Git blob header plus raw content, independent SHA-256 of content, size/mode and concurrent-mutation checks
method.manifestHash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(list, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon)) plus one LF; entries ordered by path with path, mode, type and blob fields
method.hunkReview: Every changed production hunk reviewed; whitespace-only layout ignored for semantic inspection
method.nonExecution: No build, lifecycle script, compiler program, test suite, browser or authoring command run by this audit; TypeScript parse-only AST scans are text analysis
method.priorLifecycleExecution: Root reports direct compiler/test commands, without invoking prebuild/pretest/predev. The independently observed source/artifact identities are the proof relied on here.

protectedRules: All paths below public, authoring, assets, reference, tools, desktop, playable, lookdev-tmp, scratch-tmp, screenshots
All src paths except the exact 25 reviewed runtime paths listed below
All scripts paths except the 13 engine-advancement measurement/proof scripts
excludedRules: The exact 25 runtime paths receive hunk/AST/working-byte review rather than whole-file baseline identity
tests and e2e are validation code/fixtures, including deliberately synthetic shader/quad controls
scripts/engine-advancement contains measurement and equivalence harnesses, not game asset authoring
docs and ci-reports contain prose, JSON evidence and logs; changed-file extension scan found no art/model/shader files
The one engine-runtime-validation workflow change controls acceptance jobs; other root/configuration paths have no baseline-to-candidate changes

sourceStabilityExcludedGeneratedAsset.finding: Absent from both complete Git trees and the working tree; no blob or bytes exist to hash. Source-stability exclusion is therefore independently covered as an absence check.

limitations: Snapshot identity proves preserved authored data and checked worktree bytes, not equivalence of all engine output, timing or rendering.
Changed runtime files intentionally alter ownership, input baselines, presentation pacing and lookups; numerical/behavioral regression acceptance belongs to separate tests.
The generated supplied-player-lods.bin.gz file is absent; no nonexistent blob/hash is asserted, and this audit does not generate or validate its future contents.
Shader literal detection is heuristic; complete unchanged source module hashes and the targeted renderer constructor/token comparison provide the stronger content evidence.
Git blobs identify the committed repository contents. Remote mutable assets, browser caches, generated dist output and future files are outside this immutable source audit.

Concurrent sibling documentation edits are recorded but excluded from protected-content failures. This audit does not certify subsequent commit identities unless their protected/runtime manifests are matched.
